purpose: Shows an indeterminate loading indicator for pending content or compact in-button busy states.

notes: VeliProvider supplies the default Loading aria-label language; English is the fallback.

useWhen: Content or an action is pending and the layout needs an indeterminate indicator.
A compact spinner should inherit surrounding text colour inside a busy control.

avoidWhen.situation: The layout shape should be reserved while concrete UI is loading.
avoidWhen.guidance: Compose Skeleton placeholders instead of a lone spinner.

avoidWhen.situation: A short label should explain the pending action.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use LoadingText, alone or beside Spinner.

avoidWhen.situation: A Button is waiting on an in-flight press action.
avoidWhen.guidance: Prefer Button isLoading or isPending, which already mounts the compact spinner.

approvedPatterns: Provide a translated aria-label unless the spinner is decorative with aria-hidden.
Use variant button when the spinner sits inside busy controls and should inherit text colour.
Use size sm, md, or lg to match density; default is md.
limitations: A spinner alone does not disable surrounding controls.
accessibility: Defaults to role status with a language-aware Loading label.
Pass aria-hidden when a parent live region already announces progress.
Reduced motion replaces the animation with a static dotted ring.
responsive: Size tokens keep the indicator compact across breakpoints.
rtl: Artwork is direction-neutral; labels come from VeliProvider language.
